summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of CoinArchive static homepage. All 10 sections render in correct order, all data-testids present, language toggle (EN/DE) works and persists to localStorage, hero image loads (naturalWidth=900), all 6 country cards / 8 timeline years / 5 mint marks / 6 recent cards present, stats counters show final values (650+/20+/20+), timeline year click sets active state, all 15 images load with alt text, no 404s, no console errors, mobile responsive at 390x844 with hamburger toggle that opens overlay and closes on link click, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=innerWidth=390).

issues: Several recent-card images use generic stock photography (gold bars, piggy bank, hands stacking coins) that do not depict actual 2 Euro commemorative coins matching the labels (e.g., 'Paris 2024 — Hercules', 'Italo Calvino Centenary', 'Cáceres — World Heritage'). For a 'Digital Museum / Luxury Collector Archive' feel, these should be replaced with authentic coin photography. Non-blocking, but recommended.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Replace generic stock images in recent-card-* with authentic 2 Euro commemorative coin photographs to match the museum-grade aesthetic.
critical_code_review_comments: LanguageContext.jsx: setLanguage updates state but does NOT update localStorage for SSR safety check — actually it does, but missing typeof window guard like in initial state. Minor robustness only.
Stats counters were already at final values when scrolled into view in test — verify IntersectionObserver-based animation triggers properly (visually appears to work). Non-blocking.
All components follow good practices: data-testids on all interactive/key elements, env vars used, no hardcoded URLs in frontend (static page, no API calls).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only static homepage. All testids verified at /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/home.js. Public URL: https://european-mint-museum.preview.emergentagent.com. Language persisted via localStorage key 'ca_lang'. No backend integration on homepage.
